brightport_silvear.m: I specialize in trading information, rumors, stories, and the like. Not something I could sell to a kid like you.

brightport_silvear0.m: You mean Gunfryk? He's after the rougher thieves, the ones who step outside Feygard law. Never bothered my work, so I don't bother his. But his guards? They gawk at me like hawks too.
r: Ah, that's interesting but I need something that I can "use"

brightport_silvear1.m: I do have something on him in case our current arrangement ever went sour, but you would have to do a good job of convincing me to hear it.
r: I can't pay you a lot without being sure if the information will help me, best I can do is this. [Offer 500 gold]
Im getting rid of your biggest problem without you lifting a finger, Is that not good enough?

brightport_silvear1_2.m: We've talked about this before. Im confident in my skill, the information I possess will be enough. With that in mind {1500} gold is sufficient.
r: Fine, have your price. [Give him the gold.]
I don't have that much gold on me, I'll be back later.

brightport_silvear3.m: I would sooner trust in Gunfryk dying of old age, $playername. My plans I carry alone; for yours, you'll have to pay. {1500} is my asking price.
r: Fine, have your price. [Give him the gold.]
I'll be back when I have the gold. [Leave.]

brightport_silvear4.m: Rest assured, I would not risk my contingency on shoddy information, with that in mind {1500} gold sound like a better price.
r: Fine, have your price. [Give him the gold.]
I'll be back when I have the gold. [Leave.]

brightport_silvear_1.m: I specialize in trading information, rumors, stories, and the like. Not something I could sell to a kid like you.
r: It happens that I'm interested in the local guard commander. Can you tell me anything about him?

brightport_silvear_andor.m: Though, you might be interested in what I know about your brother, Andor.
r: Andor is my dear brother, I will do whatever it takes to find him, tell me what you know.
Of course I am! That damn kid has caused me so many problems that I want to find him and smack him in the face.

brightport_silvear_andor2.m: As I mentioned, I'm a merchant. I can tell you about Andor, but it will cost you. Say, 500 gold?
r: Hey,  I've already paid you once!
For my brother it is worth that much.
I don't have that gold on me.

brightport_silvear_andor4.m: I've known your brother since his days as a student here at the academy. We spoke a few times; he was mostly interested in speaking to the boss of our Guild here in Brightport. That's all.
r: I need to talk with your boss then, where can I find them?

brightport_silvear_andor5.m: Can't complain when you're the one asking.
r: I don't have that gold on me.

brightport_silvear_bye.m: That amount shouldn't be too difficult for an adventurer like you. I'll be waiting.

brightport_silvear_bye1.m: You won't get far with that attitude. Come back when you've grown up a bit.
r: [He is right, that was childish of me.]
[Tch, if we weren't inside a town, I could show him.]

brightport_silvear_direction4.m: Sure, that was impressive for someone your age, but what goes down in Umar's turf has little to do with the Guild here in Brightport.
r: Must I remind you that the profits from Fallhaven's Guild deals with Sullengard are also reaching the Guild here in Brightport?
Argh, fine, let's return to the previous conversation.

brightport_silvear_directions.m: I already told you where to go. Head inside and use the entrance in the back. Thanks for the free gold though.

brightport_silvear_directions0.m: Yeah I don't think you should speak to me about that, bye.

brightport_silvear_directions1.m: For you, it'll be {2000} gold coins. It's our hideout, I can't just give out access for free.
r: That price seems a bit excessive "For you". I've done a lot for the Guild. I'm the one who took down Crackshot.
I can guarantee you a lot of trouble if you don't let me in, for free.
The only thing wider than my purse is my patience for the likes of you. [pay him the gold]
I don't have that gold on me.

brightport_silvear_directions3.m: To find our hideout, go inside via the door on the right. Best of luck to you.

brightport_silvear_directions5.m: OK, OK. Fine, I apologize. The Guild's policy is for me to inform new members and useful visitors of the hideout for free.

brightport_silvear_directions6.m: The entire fee thing was my own idea. Please don't tell the boss.

brightport_silvear_directions7.m: To find our hideout, head inside via the door on the right. Best of luck to you.

brightport_silvear_gunfryk.m: When he arrived here and some of my acquaintances were sent to the Feygard prisons, I had to collect some information for safety measures. Our guard commander here had a habit of visiting a certain "establishment" in Nor city, here are the records. [Silvear hands you some papers.]

brightport_silvear_initial.m: Hello there, $playername. My name is Silvear. I'm a merchant of sorts, though my merchandise is a bit, unorthodox.
r: What is it that you sell?
How do you know my name?
How do you know my name?
What is it that you were selling again?
Can you tell me about Andor again?

brightport_silviar_initial1.m: I have many ears. I know who you are, and that you are searching for your brother.
r: That doesn't make me any less suspicious of you. So, what is it that you trade?

brightport_silviar_initial2.m: I know the names of my fellow Guild members, yours especially.
r: That doesn't make me any less suspicious of you. So, what is it that you trade?

brightport_nondisplay.120: rest of the lizards killed check
brightport_nondisplay.136: thieve caught and spoke to gunfryk
brightport_nondisplay.158: locked the door for the crate quest
brightport_nondisplay.231: visited academy check by talking with dibella
brightport_nondisplay.234: LOCKED interaction with the crates during barthold's quest
brightport_nondisplay.240: started to tell gunfryk about the criminals
brightport_nondisplay.244: check so the player doesnt pay twice to hear about andor from elysa
brightport_nondisplay.254: florencia sends her regards to forenza

Thieves04.10: Umar told me to visit Defy in Sullengard to instruct him to give the villagers their share.
Thieves04.20: Defy told me that there will be a delay in giving the villagers of Sullengard their fair share for some unknown reason. I must report this to Umar at once.
Thieves04.30: Umar instructed me to talk to Defy once more.
Thieves04.35: Defy and his friends have vanished! Back to Umar ...
Thieves04.40: I told Umar about the disappearance of Defy and his men. But Umar didn't believe me and he even sent me back to find them. I better ask the villagers there.
Thieves04.50: There was a distressed man, whom just had his first child, who hinted to me of wherabouts of Defy and his men. I must report this to Umar once more.
Thieves04.60: With Sullengard running into financial trouble, Umar is enraged by Defy's traitorous way.
Thieves04.70: Umar gave me a task to give the mayor at least 50000 gold coins as the promised share for their living. After that, I'm instructed to report back to him.
Thieves04.75: Sullengard has been given their share of the gold and now it's time to revisit Umar.
Thieves04.80: At last, Sullengard can now sleep calmly and eat sufficiently with their finances restored.

brightport_goons.10: Inside a house in Brightport, I met two people named Dynes and Barthold. It turned out that they are the friends Benbyr told me to visit. Rather lacking in hospitality, they offered me work.
brightport_goons.20: Barthold was hesitant because any job I could do for them would put me at odds with Gunfryk the guard commander. Taking that into account I offered to rid them of him.
brightport_goons.30: I was told not to kill him, but surely it won't be a problem if I do. Either way I'll resolve things for them.
brightport_goons.40: I received some records from silvear that could be useful as blackmail against Gunfryk.
brightport_goons.60: I used the records to blackmail Gunfryk. To save his reputation he begrudgingly agreed to give Barthold and Dynes some leeway.
brightport_goons.50: I lied to the commander that there are some lizardmen in the derelict house east of town, I should go there and prepare an ambush.
brightport_goons.70: I ambushed and killed Gunfryk in the house to the east, along with the two guards he brought.
brightport_goons.80: I informed the commander about Barthold and Dynes' scheme. He requested that I find some incriminating evidence of their role.
brightport_goons.110: I found some of the duo's merchandise in the smuggling cave east of brightport.
brightport_goons.130: I opted to blackmail the duo instead for some quick gold. Should've had the Guild's protection, suckers!
brightport_goons.135: I told the commander I couldn't find anything
brightport_goons.136: Barthold was disappointed in me for having done nothing about Gunfryk. Little did he know I lined my pockets with his merchandise.
brightport_goons.90: Barthold was happy with my work and gave me a reward, he said I could find more work like this in Nor City.
brightport_goons.100: Barthold was a little disappointed about me killing Gunfryk. It's possible that now Feygard might take more severe action with Brightport.
brightport_goons.120: Gunfryk was happy with my work, the duo will soon be jailed. He said Feygard needs more brave youngsters like me and that I should give the military academy a try.
brightport_goons.119: I gave the commander the blade, even though I already got paid not to. If there's any honor among Nor City's thieves, they will surely have none to spare for me.
brightport_goons.140: I told the commander I couldn't find anything, even though I had the blade I blackmailed Barthold and Dynes with.

Thieves03.1: Time to rest and prepare myself to start the next job. I should go to the tavern.
Thieves03.2: I really need to take a break ....
Thieves03.3: I am now fully rested, so I should go back to Umar.
Thieves03.4: Umar told me about a group of traitors led by a veteran of the Guild. It seems he stole the Key of Luthor.
Thieves03.5: Umar went on to say that this team leader  was known as "Crackshot". He is probably also the responsible for a murder on the Duleian road.
Thieves03.10: Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding somewhere near the Duleian road. I must ask people there whether they have seen them.
Thieves03.11: It seems that Benbyr, a suspicious man outside Crossroads Guardhouse, doesn't know what I'm talking about.
Thieves03.15: A Crossroads guard told me that Feygard has sent more soldiers to the south, to try and find the criminals' hideout.
Thieves03.20: The barricade guard has a big mouth, and told me all I needed to know. The hideout is near a place full of larval burrowers. I need to move faster than the patrols to reach the hideout before them.
Thieves03.21: I found a small hole which seems to lead to a cave. Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding there.
Thieves03.22: I reached the hideout and saw some recent blood stains. Maybe there was a fight there.
Thieves03.24: I heard screams and sword clashes nearby. I should take a look.
Thieves03.25: There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.26: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found another dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.27: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found a dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.28: I found another dying soldier. There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.30: I've found the patrol sergeant. He advised me to leave this dangerous place.
Thieves03.31: The patrol sergeant told me about what happened before. He's tired and wounded, so I willl avenge his fellows.
Thieves03.32: The patrol sergeant has left to call for backup. Now I'm alone again. Time to defeat Crackshot.
Thieves03.35: I killed Crackshot and he had the key of Luthor with him. I have to go back and report to Umar.
Thieves03.36: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I cannot get the key into the lock.
Thieves03.40: The dying Crackshot said something about the key. If he told the truth, it could be cursed.
Thieves03.41: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I could not get the key turned in the lock.
Thieves03.45: I reported about the situation to Umar, and gave him the key. He did not seem to want to tell me more about the key - yet.
Thieves03.50: Finally, this job is done. Now I should take a rest and regain my strength.

bucus.10: Bucus in Fallhaven might know something about Andor. He wants me to bring him the key of Luthor from the catacombs beneath Fallhaven church.
bucus.20: The catacombs beneath Fallhaven church are closed off. Athamyr is the only one with both permission and the bravery to enter them. I should go see him in his house southwest of the church.
bucus.30: Athamyr wants me to bring him some cooked meat, then maybe he will want to talk more.
bucus.40: I brought some cooked meat to Athamyr.
bucus.50: Athamyr has given me permission to enter the catacombs beneath Fallhaven church.
bucus.100: I brought Bucus the key of Luthor.

Thieves02.2: After completing my first task I'm considered a member of Thieves' Guild. Now I have to perform a very risky task. Umar sent me to kidnap a noble woman from Feygard, without being discovered.
Thieves02.4: She was recently seen in the Foaming Flask tavern.
Thieves02.6: Umar gave me some advice. My strength is not always the solution. I must "use my tongue" to avoid raising suspicion in the tavern.
Thieves02.10: Ambelie Laumwill doesn't want to come with me peacefully. I cannot make a scene, or the guards will alert other patrols. Maybe talking with them would solve the situation.
Thieves02.15: I have "used my tongue" with the main Feygard soldier in the Foaming Flask tavern. He gave me permission to "escort back" Ambelie.
Thieves02.20: I knocked out Ambelie. I will take her back to the Guild.
Thieves02.21: I have decided not to kidnap Ambelie. I must think of another solution.
Thieves02.24: Ambelie gave me a very valuable necklace. I must talk with Umar and persuade him to no longer pursue her.
Thieves02.30: I safely brought Ambelie to the basement. However, keeping her here could be dangerous.
Thieves02.35: Umar believes there is a secure room for these types of "visitors". I should talk to Troublemaker.
Thieves02.40: I have talked to Troublemaker about the place Umar believes it's okay to safely keep the hostage.
Thieves02.45: Troublemaker has given me the key to the Guild brig. I should take Ambelie there and leave her to wake up.
Thieves02.50: I've inserted the key and moved the lever. A hatchway has opened in the room.
Thieves02.55: I left Ambelie in that ugly, dark, and cold place. I should go back.
Thieves02.60: Troublemaker gave me some bread for Ambelie. The guild doesn't want her to starve to death. Indeed, they want her to be as comfortable as possible. I must go to the brig again.
Thieves02.65: I gave the bread to Ambelie. I should report Troublemaker that I completed the job.
Thieves02.70: The job finally seems to be finished. I just have to talk with Umar again. However, I do not feel good about this. Kidnappings are definitely not my kind of job.
Thieves02.75: I completed this task successfully. Umar told me they have sent couriers to Feygard, and the ransom is almost guaranteed. He paid me for my work.
Thieves02.76: Umar took the necklace as compensation for my errors. Everything is fine again.
